text: {"features":[{"name":"Platform leverage orientation","description":"How clearly the letter understands this role as central security infrastructure whose benefits compound across many teams and systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Treats the position mainly as a generic software job and shows no real sense of centralized security leverage or organization-wide impact."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or broad impact as an attraction, but does not clearly explain why central security tooling is different from ordinary product work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Expresses clear interest in foundational or cross-organizational engineering, though the compounding effect of central security work is only lightly developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explicitly frames platform or infrastructure work as a multiplier where one improvement benefits many teams, services, or stages of the development lifecycle."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated understanding of centralized security engineering as force multiplication, capacity-building, or fleet-wide protection, and makes that logic central to the application."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement orientation","description":"How strongly the letter frames security engineering as helping developers follow secure practices with lower friction.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not present security work as serving, assisting, or unblocking developer teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Gestures at helping others or reducing toil in general terms without connecting it to developer behavior or workflow."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly presents security tooling as something that should assist developers or reduce manual work for user teams."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Emphasizes making the secure path easy, reducing friction, or embedding best practices directly into ordinary development."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates a strong philosophy of security as developer enablement rather than policing, backed by examples or reasoning about returning expert time and improving defaults."}]},{"name":"Production engineering experience","description":"Extent of demonstrated professional experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Shows only limited production maturity, with minimal described ownership of live systems or repeated lifecycle work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows some real production experience, but the scope of systems owned or the duration of experience still appears modest."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid experience across several production systems with clear exposure to testing, maintenance, and launch responsibilities."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial production maturity through multiple years of ownership across several services and repeated lifecycle responsibility."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows very strong production maturity through extensive multi-year responsibility for many production services, indicating sustained end-to-end ownership."}]},{"name":"Go depth","description":"Strength of evidence that Go is a core production language the applicant can use for the back-end systems this role requires.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or as one language among many, with no meaningful evidence of depth or relevant use."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates regular Go use but gives limited evidence of substantial back-end responsibility in Go."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is used meaningfully in production for services, infrastructure, or other relevant systems."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary or daily language tied to multiple production systems or core back-end work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to the applicant's profile and directly connects it to designing and operating the kinds of back-end systems named in the posting."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant can use Python effectively for production services, automation, and tooling.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python, or mentions it so briefly that real working proficiency is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Indicates some Python use, but mostly as light scripting or vague familiarity without meaningful production detail."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular Python use for professional automation, analysis, tooling, or rapid prototypes."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production Python experience through services, internal tooling, or automation that other engineers depend on."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep, production-grade Python fluency through substantial services or widely used automation, often with signals of maintainability such as typed, tested, or extensible code."}]},{"name":"Agentic architecture experience","description":"Quality of evidence that the applicant has designed systems combining autonomous agents with controlled back-end infrastructure.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agentic systems, or uses agent language only as a buzzword without architectural substance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agents or autonomous workflows but gives little indication of how the system was structured or controlled."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a relevant setup involving agents and back-end services, but with limited detail about task boundaries or orchestration."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Clearly explains an end-to-end architecture in which agents handle bounded work while services provide orchestration, permissions, or auditing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows sophisticated security-aware agent design with explicit autonomy boundaries, guardrails, supervision, permissions, or auditability suited to sensitive workflows."}]},{"name":"Production AI experience","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has built AI-backed functionality in production and understands how to make it dependable.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no evidence of AI experience beyond general interest or buzzwords."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Says they have worked with AI or language models but gives little sense of production deployment or operational learning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows concrete experience shipping AI-backed features or integrating models into real workflows."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows production AI experience plus explicit attention to evaluation, reliability, trustworthiness, or failure modes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates strong production AI judgment by pairing shipped AI systems with clear hardening, evaluation scaffolding, or other practices for dependable operation."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability automation experience","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant has automated vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related response workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention automating vulnerability handling, or speaks only in abstract terms about security automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions security automation generally but gives no concrete vulnerability workflow or personal contribution."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes building automation for vulnerability intake or triage with basic classification, prioritization, or routing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership of meaningful vulnerability-handling automation, such as structured pipelines, deduplication, prioritization, or routing to the right owners."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates highly relevant end-to-end experience designing vulnerability-handling systems that materially reduced manual security workload or scaled expert attention."}]},{"name":"Security assessment experience","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant can perform structured security reviews and reason about attack surfaces and remediation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no real evidence of conducting security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests limited exposure to security reviews without describing method, scope, or follow-through."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Indicates real assessment work such as threat modeling, review participation, or targeted audits of services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes structured assessments with concrete practices such as attack-surface mapping, attacker-style code review, documented findings, or validation of fixes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows strong assessment capability across multiple contexts and presents security review as disciplined engineering work that informs design and remediation."}]},{"name":"Algorithmic depth","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant applies data structures and algorithms to improve real systems.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms, or mentions them only as a generic comfort area."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims algorithmic strength but provides no concrete example of applying it to an actual engineering problem."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Provides one clear example of using a better algorithm or data structure to solve a performance or correctness issue."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Gives specific, credible examples showing strong practical algorithmic judgment on meaningful production problems."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional fluency by showing algorithmic thinking as a recurring tool for redesigning core systems or eliminating major bottlenecks or bug classes."}]},{"name":"Security engagement","description":"Degree to which the letter shows self-driven security development through certifications, competitions, or sustained offensive practice outside routine job duties.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Offers no security-development signal beyond ordinary job claims."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes one modest extra signal, such as a baseline certification or occasional security competition participation."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a meaningful extra security investment through recurring practice, a purposeful credential, or a clear attacker-mindset learning habit."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows substantial external security commitment, such as a demanding hands-on certification or consistently strong competitive security participation."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates unusually strong self-driven security credibility through multiple strong signals or clearly standout offensive-learning achievement."}]},{"name":"Open-source stewardship","description":"Strength of evidence that the applicant contributes to or maintains open-source software in a way that shows engineering ownership.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source contribution or maintenance."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional patches or ad hoc fixes, with little sign of ongoing responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows recurring upstream contributions or a habit of fixing defects in dependencies rather than only reporting them."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows clear ownership by maintaining an open-source project or handling contribution review and releases."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial open-source stewardship of a project with real outside users, including sustained maintenance, review, and release responsibility."}]},{"name":"Personal engineering initiative","description":"Quality of self-initiated technical work outside formal job duties that demonstrates curiosity and engineering depth.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Gives no evidence of self-directed technical work outside normal employment."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a small side project or casual tinkering with limited technical ambition or relevance."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a personal build that shows sustained effort or useful applied learning beyond day-to-day work."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes an ambitious side project involving substantial systems complexity, such as distribution, recovery, consistency, or failure handling."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows unusually strong self-directed initiative through a sustained, technically demanding project chosen specifically to tackle hard engineering problems."}]},{"name":"Concrete evidence","description":"How concretely the letter supports its claims with examples, mechanisms, scope, or outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims and aspirations, leaving important qualifications largely unsupported."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Provides some specifics, but many central claims remain vague or unsubstantiated."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports most key claims with concrete examples, though details on mechanism or impact are still somewhat limited."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Frequently uses precise examples, technical context, or clear results to substantiate qualifications."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds claims in concrete, credible detail about what was built, how it worked, and what effect it had."}]},{"name":"Writing organization","description":"Clarity and logical flow of the letter as a persuasive application document.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Feels fragmented or hard to follow, with sequencing that weakens the overall case for fit."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has a recognizable structure, but transitions or paragraph sequencing are uneven and the case develops only loosely."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Is generally clear and coherent, with a sensible progression from background to fit to supporting evidence."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Guides the reader smoothly through a well-structured case, with paragraphs that each advance a distinct part of the application."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is exceptionally well organized and easy to follow, with crisp framing, strong sequencing, and a cumulative argument that becomes more persuasive as it unfolds."}]},{"name":"Writing mechanics","description":"Correctness and polish of spelling, grammar, and proofreading.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent noticeable errors that repeatedly interrupt reading or call care into question."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains several visible errors, but the message remains understandable without much effort."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains a few minor errors that do not materially undermine readability."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is largely clean and professional, with at most isolated slips."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is essentially error-free and reads as carefully proofread."}]}]}
